query:
SELECT 'planilha' as fonte,
  status,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(valor AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) as valor
FROM cobranca_planilha
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY total DESC;
